variant: RADIAN event 030: receipt acknowledgement with the person who receives
source_request: Postman apidian-v2.1 / 08 - Generador de Eventos / Enviar un evento indicando el CUFE
derived: Fictitious received invoice, issuer and person. The script receives the data that sendeventdata would read from the invoice XML downloaded from the DIAN; event_id and issuer_party as in the Postman request
php_bugs: sts:QRCode always points to the production catalog (https://catalogo-vpfe.dian.gov.co), even though the company is in habilitacion (ProfileExecutionID 2): DocumentTrait::createXML (lines 276-277) hardcodes that URL for type 88. The documentkey of the QR is the CUFE of the referenced invoice (SignInvoice::ConsultarCUFEEVENT returns the second cbc:UUID), not the CUDE of the event. Suspected PHP bug for T6 to confirm against the RADIAN annex; the CUDE itself is correct.
